chapter_title: Concerning the Three Things that were established
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶2:**

Three spiritual operations are brought about by Divine Wisdom out of necessity . They are not arbitrary but flow from the very nature of divine order — they cannot remain un accomplished. For the ruling love of self and falsity, which from the beginning set itself against Divine Wisdom, must be restrained by these three operations. Because this is so , there is no other outcome ; these must come into existence .

**¶3:**

The first operation is the establishment of a new state of good in the exterior mind — a regenerated natural mind, founded and built over the old unregenerate natural mind, that alien structure of inherited evil upon which it is raised .

**¶4:**

The second operation is this : the powers of divine order will en close and contain the new state of good around self -love — that consuming interior fals ity which is the companion and instrument of the ruling evil.

** ¶5:** The third operation concerns the perv erted affections of all who have confirmed themselves in evil through repeated acts. These affections have been jud ged according to the fals ities they freely chose , and because of this they are fixed permanently upon the very principle of self -love that had exalted itself against the Divine — exposed and fast ened to the evil they served .

**¶6:**

This final consolidated mass of evil is sealed shut when every appearance, every sem blance and im itation of good and truth in every possible form, is fixed and made permanent within it. All such perv erted affections are bound by this last and eternal restraint and are reduced to the lowest and most ab ject condition — made a footstool and a covering and a cast off beneath that containment which is the prison of the ruling evil. This sealed state is established as a perpetual boundary and an absolute void between the two: between falsity in its interior nature and evil in its active will — so that they can no longer communicate, nor can their infl ux reach one another. Rather, they become utt erly barren, separated from each other to et ernity — evil unable to conce ive new fals ity , fals ity unable to kindle new evil — forever.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Three things would be fashioned by the Light through necessity. For there can be no other way nor other result, to allow them to stay without coming about. For the Darkness, the Enemy, must be bound by them; he who stood up against the Light from the beginning. Due to this, these things have no (other) result, to allow them to stay without coming about.
Now, the first thing is the new luminous earth, which was set and built on top of this earth [that lies beneath] it, namely that alien body [of Darkness; and it was] built upon it.
The second thing is this: They will [fashion] and they [will establish] the new earth, the coffin [and the enclosure] of the dark fire, the companion of the Enemy.

The third thing is the souls of all the sinners who have been condemned by their deeds. They were [judged and there was called] over them woe; they have been condemned according to the wicked deeds they had committed, and due to this they will be crucified on the Enemy, he who had raised himself up against the Greatness.

They will seal up this final lump when all the likenesses and images of every shape will be nailed in it. Also, those will be bound by this last fetter for eternity, and be placed as a footstool and a mat and a rag for this coffin [of the dark fire] which is the prison of the Enemy. It will be placed, being a boundary-marker and a great void between the two, between the Darkness and the Enemy, so that they cannot reach one another, nor can they hear their voices; rather they will become sterile as they are separated from each other for ever and ever.
